title: At fixed cutoff the full polynomial Krylov tower reaches the exact Wick multiplication endpoint

finite_cutoff_endpoint.square_completion: At fixed N, W_N=V_N+6C_N^2=integral(phi_N(x)^2-3C_N)^2 dx>=0 and X_N=V_N/sigma_N is bounded below by -L_N with L_N=6C_N^2/sigma_N
finite_cutoff_endpoint.exact_essential_infimum: The finite Fourier Gaussian has full support. Constant configurations phi_N(x)=plus-or-minus sqrt(3C_N) lie in that support and make W_N zero, so ess inf X_N=-L_N
finite_cutoff_endpoint.hardy_determinacy: For Z_N=X_N+L_N=W_N/sigma_N>=0, finite-dimensional norm equivalence gives sqrt(Z_N)<=A_N(1+||G_N||^2). Hence E exp(c_N sqrt(Z_N))<infinity for some c_N>0, the Hardy criterion makes the Stieltjes moment problem determinate, and the associated Jacobi operator is essentially self-adjoint
finite_cutoff_endpoint.tower_limit: The nested finite Jacobi bottoms therefore satisfy lambda_min(J_(d,N)) decreasing to ess inf X_N=-6C_N^2/sigma_N as d tends to infinity for each fixed N
finite_cutoff_endpoint.endpoint_scale: Since C_N=Theta(N^2) and sigma_N=Theta(N^(5/2)), the fixed-cutoff endpoint magnitude L_N is Theta(N^(3/2))
finite_cutoff_endpoint.noncommuting_limits: The Hardy constant, polynomial degree needed for localization and free H0 cost are N-dependent. Fixed-N convergence does not prove that c_d is unbounded after N tends to infinity, does not control a degree d(N), and does not determine E_N
finite_cutoff_endpoint.ceiling: The endpoint belongs to multiplication by X_N. It is not the ground-energy correction of H0+gW_N and supplies no uniform ultraviolet localization or lower bound
